name: 棋齐垒（黑子）
evolution: 棋棋（黑子） Lv.26 → 棋齐垒（黑子） → 棋契陛下
description: “黑子从不主动寻找白子，但是却总会在转向的时候留下一排空位，学者推测这是黑子对换班记忆的折射，即便时代更迭，它们仍在试图完成那场和白子的交接。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十四》
descriptionEn: The black pieces never actively seek the white pieces, yet always leave a row of empty spaces when turning. Scholars speculate this reflects the black pieces' memory of shift changes; even as eras pass, they still try to complete that handover with the white pieces. — 'The Earth Craftsmen of the Golden Age · XIV'
